text:
the history of melancholy

includes us all.

I twist among the dirty sheets

while I fix my gaze

on the blue walls

and nothing.

I have grown so used to melancholy

that

I greet it like an old

friend.

now I will have 15 minutes of affliction

for the redhead who left,

I will tell the gods.

I feel really bad

really sad

then I get up

PURIFIED

though I have solved

nothing

(...)

there is something wrong with me

besides

melancholy

translation.title: The History of Melancholy...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the casual ritual of melancholy, brief purification, and unresolved final admission.
